AGENDA ITEMS AND ACTIONS
“In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the City Clerk’s office at 310-952-1720  prior to the meeting.” (Government Code Section 54954.2)

CALL TO ORDER: CITY COUNCIL

ROLL CALL: Recess to Special meeting at 7:00pm 

During Roll call 

MPTJD noted he did not receive notice of special meeting. He waives his right for noticing.

**ORAL COMMUNICATIONS**

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FOR MATTERS LISTED ON THE AGENDA (MEMBERS OF THE PUBLIC)  City Clerk read public comment.

DISCUSSION: (Item 1)

ORAL COMMUNICATIONS (COUNCIL MEMBERS)

ADJOURNMENT

1.. CONSIDER APPROVAL OF A DRIVE-THRU COVID-19 TESTING SITE AT THE JUANITA MILLENDER-MC-DONALD COMMUNITY CENTER IN THE CITY OF CARSON (CITY COUNCIL)  -  Action: adopted (Pass) Moved by Jim Dear Mayor Robles offered comments expressing the need for a testing site in Carson. He noted the proposed vendor will provide free tests for all City of Carson residents at no cost to the city.  

JD inquired of the name of vendor - US Health Fairs 

Council member spoke about his excitement of establishing a testing site in location.

Assistant CM Roberts gave a brief staff report. noting the testing will take place by appointment only and swab testing.

Mayor Pro tem inquired about insurance billing. Staff addressed his question. 

Friendly amendment that the program be opened up to people that work in Carson after City Employees and City Residents.

LDH inquired how the medical provider is able to get results back in 24-hours. She also inquired about how the grab and go work in coordination with the testing site. Staff addressed her inquiry, noting that Sheriff and Task Force have vetted a mapped traffic plan. 

Discussion ensued about the need for volunteers 14 is needed on a daily basis and 9am - 6pm daily. 

LDH inquired about repurposing city employees. City Manager noted that she has been in communication with employees who are wanting to come back to work. 

JD inquired if staff that are repurposed 

CH inquired about protocols that will be in place if there is a resident testing positive and what happens if the resident does not have insurance. If staff has been in communication with Harbor UCLA to notify them of the potential volume in patient care in addition to which days will testing take place. 

ACM Roberts addressed CH inquiry.

MPTJD inquired if the vendor has the capability to do antibodies testing. 

AR directed staff to prepare for a press conference this Thursday.
